subject: Re: draft revisions
text: Thanks for flagging that, and I agree the timeline felt unclear. I read the original note as asking for a light rewrite only, but the comment about new structure made me think I should reorder the sections first. That probably caused the mismatch. Going forward, I’ll ask before changing headings or dropping any part. For now, I’ve restored your previous order and will send the updated copy by tonight. If you prefer, we can mark which edits are optional so nothing gets lost in translation again. Let me know if anything else looked odd today.
